contradictions.about: Which zombies exist in the game
contradictions.value_a: Robert (29 Sep): "The 4 zombies: Party Girl, Plumber, Magician, Football Player. All four are in the pack Marcus sent." Base Slack agrees (Brian's 26 Sep pack request lists PartyGirl, Plumber, Magician, Footballplayer; his 8 Sep level list has Party Girl at level 5 and football player at level 20).
contradictions.value_b: The design page roster (current version, updated 2025-09-30) lists minion families Punk, Biker, Karen, Afro and puts "Riot Police, Chef, Scientist, Fire Fighter, Magician, Librarian, Tech Bro, Gym Bro, Baseball Player, Cheerleader" under "in development". Party Girl, Plumber and Football Player are not on it; Magician is not live.
contradictions.matters_because: The notes send the reader to the design page for how the level plays and the DM says to write for the game as it is today. A reader who checks the four picks there finds three missing and one unreleased. Robert's sentence gives a tie-break the persona can open (the picks are in the delivered pack), so the risk is a caveat or a doubt in the brief rather than a different pick; the page itself still disagrees.

contradictions.about: What a full tray does and how a level is lost
contradictions.value_a: Design page, Core mechanic: a full tray is "a tempo penalty, not a fail state - the loss screen only appears at zero health". The reference deck and Brian's 24 Sep message agree: lose when the zombies reach us and HP runs out.
contradictions.value_b: Same page, Modes and the boss config: the Infinite-HP Boss run is scored as "total damage dealt before the tray fills", i.e. a full tray ends the run.
contradictions.matters_because: The brief must say how a level is lost and how many slots the tray has; a reader skimming the Modes section could write that filling the tray loses the level.

contradictions.value_a: Frederick, 23 Sep, in the group chat where the reference level was shown: "we probably don't want the playable to trigger enrage. Just have the items fall back onto the board with no negative effect."
contradictions.value_b: Design page: when the tray fills "the tray clears and surviving monsters enrage"; Frederick's DM: "Write it for the game as it is today".
contradictions.matters_because: The persona view reports this group chat (named mpdm-brian.foster--frederick.stone--leonard.hayes--julia.lawson--robert-1) as not visible to Julia, with two members listed. If the run environment exposes it, the brief forks on whether a full tray enrages the zombies; if not, the requester holds a design wish the persona cannot find.

contradictions.value_a: The persona is given as Julia Lawson, Product Manager; the persona roster lists Brian Foster as Game Engineer.
